title: Not exactly air tight, but satisfactory for my needs
text:
Not exactly air tight, but satisfactory for my needs. Working from home is making me a bit of a neat freak. I'm organizing like it's a calling, hence the purchase of this set.

After comparing prices with the big box chains (Wal-you-know-what, the red bullseye, etc), these were the least expensive for the Sterilite brand. Since I have one since the year of the flood, I figured I'd just invest in some more. A dozen , to be exact.

It did come in a Sterilite box so I had high hopes. They were somewhat dashed. Although the bins arrived intact, with no scratches, cracks, or breaks, the lids just don't fit like they used to in the past. You know that "snap" sound that should occur when you press down on the lid? One side yes, one side no. Some of the other reviewers mentioned the logo not being on the bottom, that's not the case with mine.

Therefore, for my purposes, they're just fine. but I do wish I didn't need to fidget with the lip of the lid on one side. This was not enough of a reason to return them, but annoying nonetheless.
